title: Website Returns HTTP 502 Bad Gateway
symptom: Browser displays '502 Bad Gateway' when accessing application via reverse proxy or ALB.
initial_observations: Proxy server (Nginx or ALB) is reachable.
Backend upstream application service fails to return a valid HTTP response.
environment: Nginx reverse proxy pointing to upstream Gunicorn/Node.js app.

possible_causes.cause: Upstream application process (Node, Gunicorn, PHP-FPM) crashed or not running
possible_causes.evidence_needed: Nginx error log: 'connect() failed (111: Connection refused) while connecting to upstream'.
possible_causes.remediation: Start or restart backend process with systemctl and inspect application crash trace.

possible_causes.cause: Upstream listening on wrong port or Unix domain socket permission issue
possible_causes.evidence_needed: Socket file missing or owned by wrong user.
possible_causes.remediation: Ensure backend listens on configured port/socket and socket file permissions allow proxy user access.

investigation_steps.title: Check Reverse Proxy Error Log
investigation_steps.explanation: Identifies whether upstream refused connection, timed out, or sent empty response.
investigation_steps.what_to_look_for: Connection refused or no live upstreams while connecting to upstream.

investigation_steps.title: Check Status of Upstream Application Service
investigation_steps.explanation: Confirm backend application daemon is active.
investigation_steps.what_to_look_for: Active: active (running) vs failed or dead.

prevention: Implement robust health checks and monitoring.
